title: Pro Shop Store Credit: tier's own reinstatement charge
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers the tier's own standing charge for reinstating a suspended account, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
Reinstating a suspended Pro Shop Store Credit account charges the tier's own standing reinstatement fee, where that tier has set one greater than zero; a tier whose standing reinstatement fee is zero charges nothing under this basis.
